notes.subject: חמור / חמרתים
notes.rationale: Pun on 'donkey' (ḥamor) and 'heap' (ḥamortayim, dual 'two heaps') — 'with the donkey's jawbone, a heap, two heaps' — the sound-play is lost in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: חמור חמרתים
notes.rationale: Read either as 'heap upon heaps' (bodies piled) or as continued pun 'an ass upon asses' (the Philistines as donkeys) — YLT takes the second.

notes.subject: wan tausen man
notes.rationale: The victory song closes with the count of one thousand, repeating the number from v15.

translation: Na Simson i tok: Wantaim han bilong het bilong donki, ol hip, olgeta hip; wantaim han bilong het bilong donki mi paitim wan tausen man.
